statement_en: It is important to note that the condition is that for every symmetric interval $I_{\varepsilon}(L)$ centered at some real number $L$, there are only finitely many terms outside the interval, rather than merely infinitely many terms inside it. This difference is illustrated by the sequence $$b_n=\begin{cases}1&\text{n is even}\\ -1&\text{n is odd}\end{cases}.$$ This sequence has no limit.
